subject.title: feat(provider): add Unikraft Cloud service provider

question: Should Crabbox accept Unikraft Cloud as a built-in service-control provider, or should this integration stay external for now?
rationale: The adapter fits the provider boundary and has live zero-residue proof, but accepting a funded remote provider into core is a support and product-scope choice automation cannot make.

options.title: Accept Built-In Provider
options.body: Approve this as a core service-control provider after the release-owned changelog line is removed and normal merge gates pass.

options.title: Keep It External For Now
options.body: Ask the contributor to maintain Unikraft Cloud outside the built-in provider list until Crabbox maintainers want to sponsor it in core.

options.title: Request Maintainer Live Smoke
options.body: Keep the PR open while a maintainer repeats or sponsors one more live create/use/destroy validation before accepting built-in scope.

recommendation.title: Accept Built-In Provider
recommendation.body: Approve this as a core service-control provider after the release-owned changelog line is removed and normal merge gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on provider lifecycle safety and already authored Unikraft hardening commits on this branch.
